title: Notice to Data Principals
description: The Data Fiduciary must provide a clear and accessible notice to the Data Principal before or at the time of collecting personal data, describing what data is collected, the purpose, and how it is used.
assessment_question: Does the privacy policy provide a clear notice describing personal data collection, purpose, and usage?

title: Purpose of Processing Personal Data
description: Personal data must be processed only for specified, clear, and lawful purposes. The policy should clearly state the purposes for which personal data is collected and used.
assessment_question: Does the policy clearly state the specific purposes for which personal data is collected and processed?

title: Types of Personal Data Collected
description: The policy should identify the categories or types of personal data that are collected from Data Principals.
assessment_question: Does the policy identify what categories of personal data are collected?

title: Consent Mechanism
description: Processing of personal data must be based on free, specific, informed, unconditional, and unambiguous consent. The policy should describe how consent is obtained and how it can be withdrawn.
assessment_question: Does the policy describe how consent is obtained and how a Data Principal can withdraw consent?

title: Data Principal Rights
description: The policy should inform Data Principals of their rights, including: right to access information, right to correction and erasure, right to grievance redressal, and right to nominate.
assessment_question: Does the policy inform Data Principals about their rights under the DPDP Act?

title: Data Retention and Erasure
description: Personal data must not be retained for longer than necessary for the specified purpose. The policy should describe how long data is retained and when/how it is erased or de-identified.
assessment_question: Does the policy describe the data retention period and the process for erasure or de-identification?

title: Security Safeguards
description: The Data Fiduciary must implement reasonable security safeguards to protect personal data from breaches. The policy should describe what security measures are in place.
assessment_question: Does the policy describe the security measures implemented to protect personal data?

title: Data Sharing and Third-Party Disclosure
description: The policy should disclose whether personal data is shared with third parties, for what purposes, and what safeguards apply. Data Processors must be engaged through valid contracts.
assessment_question: Does the policy disclose data sharing with third parties and the conditions under which data is shared?

title: Grievance Redressal Mechanism
description: The Data Fiduciary must provide an effective grievance redressal mechanism. The policy should provide clear contact details and describe the process for Data Principals to raise complaints.
assessment_question: Does the policy describe a grievance redressal mechanism with contact information?

title: Processing of Children’s Personal Data
description: Before processing a child’s personal data (persons under 18), the Data Fiduciary must obtain verifiable parental consent. The policy should address how children’s data is handled.
assessment_question: Does the policy address the collection or processing of personal data belonging to children?
